limitations: Inventory is not proof that a control was activated or its business action passed.
Checks preserve only explicit attachment actions. A named panel is not a separately recorded tab-click assertion.
Functional tests are separate evidence, never automatically assigned to individual controls.
Identical role/route/panel/label/id/type/href/tag/control-role entries are deduplicated; occurrences and all conditions remain traceable.
Missing routes or controls are not inferred as tested. Partial/failed cases retain their actual attempt status.
